description: This file defines the HomeViewModel class for the Android application, responsible for managing and providing recipe data to the Home screen. It interacts with the RecipeRepository to fetch all recipes asynchronously using coroutines and LiveData.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel that loads recipe data from a repository and exposes it via LiveData for UI observation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Triggers the asynchronous loading of all recipes from the repository and updates the LiveData.
